categories.desc: Getting a table and the menu.
cards: A table for two, please.
နှစ်ယောက်စာ စားပွဲ တစ်လုံး ရနိုင်မလား။
Say how many people. For three: A table for three, please.
— Hello! — Hi, a table for four, please.
Do you have a table by the window?
Asks for a place you like. Also: outside, in the corner.
Do you have a table outside?
အပြင်ဘက်မှာ စားပွဲ ရှိလား။
Is this seat free?
Before you sit next to strangers. Free here means no one is sitting there.
Excuse me, is this seat free?
Can I see the menu, please?
မီနူး ကြည့်လို့ ရမလား။
The menu is the list of food and prices.
Can we see the menu, please? And some water?
မီနူး ကြည့်လို့ ရမလား။ ရေလည်း နည်းနည်း။

categories.my: မှာယူခြင်း
categories.desc: Saying what you want, and asking about the food.
cards: I'll have the fried rice.
ထမင်းကြော် ယူမယ်။
The usual way to order. Not: I want… (it can sound rude).
I'll have the noodle soup, please.
ခေါက်ဆွဲပြုတ် ယူမယ်။
Can I get a mango juice?
သရက်သီးဖျော်ရည် တစ်ခွက် ရမလား။
Casual and very common, especially in cafés. Can I have…? is a little more polite.
Can I get a coffee with milk, please?
နို့ကော်ဖီ တစ်ခွက် ရမလား။
What do you recommend?
ဘာ စားသင့်လဲ အကြံပေးပါဦး။
Asks the waiter for the best or most popular dish.
It all looks good. What do you recommend?
အကုန် ကောင်းပုံ ရတယ်။ ဘာ စားသင့်လဲ အကြံပေးပါဦး။
Is it spicy?
စပ်လား။
Very useful! Also: Is it very spicy? Not too spicy, please.
— Is it spicy? — Just a little.
— စပ်လား။ — နည်းနည်းပဲ။
Without ice, please.
ရေခဲ မထည့်ပါနဲ့။
Asks for something to be left out. The opposite: with extra ice.
A lemon juice without sugar, please.
သံပုရာရည် သကြား မထည့်ဘဲ တစ်ခွက်။
I'm vegetarian.
သက်သတ်လွတ် စားပါတယ်။
You don't eat meat or fish. Ask: Is there meat in this?
I'm vegetarian. Is there meat in this soup?
သက်သတ်လွတ် စားပါတယ်။ ဒီဟင်းချိုထဲမှာ အသား ပါလား။

categories.desc: Questions you will hear, so you can answer quickly.
cards: Are you ready to order?
Answer: Yes, please. Or: Not yet. Can we have a few more minutes?
— Are you ready to order? — Not yet, sorry.
For here or to go?
ဒီမှာ စားမလား၊ ပါဆယ်လား။
Eat in the café, or take it away. British English: Eat in or take away?
— For here or to go? — To go, please.
— ဒီမှာ စားမလား၊ ပါဆယ်လား။ — ပါဆယ်ပါ။
Anything to drink?
သောက်စရာ ဘာယူမလဲ။
Answer with your drink, or: Just water, please.
— Anything to drink? — Just water, please.
— သောက်စရာ ဘာယူမလဲ။ — ရေပဲ ပေးပါ။
Is everything OK?
The waiter checks during the meal. Answer: Yes, it's great, thanks!
— Is everything OK? — Yes, it's delicious, thanks!

categories.desc: Asking for more, or saying politely that something is wrong.
cards: Could we have some water?
ရေ နည်းနည်း ရနိုင်မလား။
Start with Excuse me to call the waiter politely. Don't snap your fingers.
Excuse me, could we have some water?
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ ရေ နည်းနည်း ရနိုင်မလား။
Can we have some more rice?
ထမင်း နည်းနည်း ထပ်ရနိုင်မလား။
Some more = an extra amount.
This is great. Can we have some more rice?
ဒါ အရမ်း ကောင်းတယ်။ ထမင်း နည်းနည်း ထပ်ရနိုင်မလား။
This isn't what I ordered.
ဒါ မှာထားတာ မဟုတ်ဘူး။
Polite if you say it calmly. Then say what you ordered.
Sorry, this isn't what I ordered. I asked for chicken.
It's a bit cold.
နည်းနည်း အေးနေတယ်။
A bit makes a complaint softer. Ask: Could you heat it up, please?
Excuse me, my soup is a bit cold.
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ ဟင်းချိုက နည်းနည်း အေးနေတယ်။

categories.desc: Asking for the bill, taking food home, saying thank you.
cards: Could we have the bill, please?
Polite. In American English: Could we have the check, please?
Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ ငွေ ရှင်းမယ်နော်။
Can I pay at the counter?
In some places you pay at the table, in others at the counter.
Can I pay at the counter, or do you bring the bill?
ကောင်တာမှာ ငွေရှင်းလို့ ရမလား၊ ဒါမှမဟုတ် ဘောက်ချာ ယူလာပေးမလား။
Can I take this home?
ဒါ အိမ် ယူသွားလို့ ရမလား။
For food you didn't finish. Also: Can I have a box for this?
I can't finish it. Can I take this home?
မကုန်နိုင်တော့ဘူး။ ဒါ အိမ် ယူသွားလို့ ရမလား။
That was lovely, thank you.
အရမ်း ကောင်းပါတယ်၊ ကျေးဇူးပါ။
What you say to the waiter or cook as you leave.
Thank you, that was lovely. We'll come again.
ကျေးဇူးပါ၊ အရမ်း ကောင်းပါတယ်။ နောက်လည်း လာဦးမယ်။
